reuse.why: Routes four sites that had copied the midpoint dispatch through the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper, and puts the range rule in one new function.

duplication.why: Removes five copies of the midpoint logic; only schedule-template keeps a small op-based ternary around getWorstCaseAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where the tree keeps schedule amount logic.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: A single definition every planning path uses; the schedule-template dispatch on op is a minor leftover.

one_place.where: getWorstCaseAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount (preview, posting, actions sync, forecast) and directly by budget/schedule-template.ts.
